title: The multiplication of the constant group scheme: the components of T_E x_T T_E and the glued morphism
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $E$ an abelian group. Let $T_E=\coprod_{e\in E}T$ be a coproduct of copies of $T$ indexed by $E$, with coprojections $\iota_e:T\to T_E$ [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-coproduct-family], let $\pi:T_E\to T$ be the morphism with $\pi\circ\iota_e=\mathrm{id}_T$ for all $e\in E$, and $V_e=\iota_e(T)\subseteq T_E$. Let $P=T_E\times_{\pi,T,\pi}T_E$ be the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product] with projections $p,q:P\to T_E$, put $\rho=\pi\circ p=\pi\circ q:P\to T$, and $W_{e,e'}=p^{-1}(V_e)\cap q^{-1}(V_{e'})\subseteq P$ for $(e,e')\in E\times E$. Then: (a) the $W_{e,e'}$ are open and closed subsets of $P$, $W_{e,e'}\cap W_{d,d'}=\varnothing$ for $(e,e')\ne(d,d')$, and $P=\bigcup_{(e,e')\in E\times E}W_{e,e'}$; (b) regarding each $W_{e,e'}$ as an open subscheme of $P$ [def-weil-open-immersion], there is a unique morphism of schemes $m:P\to T_E$ with $m|_{W_{e,e'}}=\iota_{e+e'}\circ\rho|_{W_{e,e'}}$ for all $(e,e')\in E\times E$; (c) $\pi\circ m=\rho$, $m(W_{e,e'})\subseteq V_{e+e'}$ for all $(e,e')$, and consequently $m^{-1}(V_d)=\bigcup_{e+e'=d}W_{e,e'}$ for every $d\in E$.

source.place: Groupoids, Example 39.5.6 (Tag 03YW, label example-constant-group): 'The morphism giving the group structure is the morphism $G\times G\to G$ which maps the component corresponding to the pair $(g,g')$ to the component corresponding to $gg'$' (over $\Spec\mathbf Z$, then base changed to $S$); that the pairs index a decomposition of the fibre product into open and closed pieces and that the componentwise maps glue to one morphism is not written out in Stacks, so the proof is to be written by an agent (gluing: Schemes Section 26.14, Tag 01JA)

Covering: for $x\in P$ choose $e$ with $p(x)\in V_e$ and $e'$ with $q(x)\in V_{e'}$ (the $V$'s cover $T_E$); then $x\in W_{e,e'}$. This proves (a). proof.text: *Step 2 (the local morphisms and their compatibility).* Regard each $W_{e,e'}$ as an open subscheme of $P$ with inclusion $j_{e,e'}:W_{e,e'}\to P$, an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion], and put $\rho|_{W_{e,e'}}=\rho\circ j_{e,e'}$ and $m_{e,e'}=\iota_{e+e'}\circ\rho|_{W_{e,e'}}:W_{e,e'}\to T_E$. By (a) the $W_{e,e'}$ form an open cover of $P$. The compatibility condition of [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-morphism-gluing] holds: for $(e,e')=(d,d')$ both restrictions are the same morphism; for $(e,e')\ne(d,d')$ the overlap $W_{e,e'}\cap W_{d,d'}$ is empty by (a), so it is the empty scheme, which is an initial object of the category of schemes (a morphism from $\varnothing$ is the empty map of spaces with the unique map of sheaves into the zero sheaf on $\varnothing$), and any two morphisms $\varnothing\to T_E$, in particular $m_{e,e'}|_{\varnothing}$ and $m_{d,d'}|_{\varnothing}$, are equal.

source.place: Schemes, Section 26.14 (Tag 01JA, glueing schemes) and Lemma 26.14.1 (Tag 01JB, lemma-glue) with $U_{ij}=\varnothing$ for $i\ne j$

proof.text: *Step 3 (existence and uniqueness of $m$; part (b)).* By Step 2 and the gluing lemma [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-morphism-gluing] applied to the open cover $P=\bigcup_{(e,e')\in E\times E}W_{e,e'}$ and the morphisms $m_{e,e'}$, there is a unique morphism of schemes $m:P\to T_E$ with $m|_{W_{e,e'}}=m_{e,e'}=\iota_{e+e'}\circ\rho|_{W_{e,e'}}$ for all $(e,e')\in E\times E$. This is (b).

source.place: Schemes, Section 26.14 (Tag 01JA, glueing schemes), Lemma 26.14.1 (Tag 01JB, lemma-glue), mapping property $\mathrm{Mor}(X,Y)$ of a glued scheme, here for the disjoint cover by the $W_{e,e'}$; applied to the multiplication of Groupoids, Example 39.5.6 (Tag 03YW)

proof.text: *Step 4 ($\pi\circ m=\rho$ and $m(W_{e,e'})\subseteq V_{e+e'}$).* For every $(e,e')$, $(\pi\circ m)|_{W_{e,e'}}=\pi\circ m\circ j_{e,e'}=\pi\circ\iota_{e+e'}\circ\rho\circ j_{e,e'}=\rho\circ j_{e,e'}=\rho|_{W_{e,e'}}$, using $\pi\circ\iota_{e+e'}=\mathrm{id}_T$. So $\pi\circ m$ and $\rho$ are two morphisms $P\to T$ whose restrictions to every member of the open cover $(W_{e,e'})$ agree, hence $\pi\circ m=\rho$ by the uniqueness clause of [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-morphism-gluing]. On points, $m(W_{e,e'})=(m\circ j_{e,e'})(W_{e,e'})=\iota_{e+e'}(\rho(W_{e,e'}))\subseteq\iota_{e+e'}(T)=V_{e+e'}$.

source.place: Groupoids, Example 39.5.6 (Tag 03YW): the multiplication 'maps the component corresponding to the pair (g,g') to the component corresponding to gg''; with Schemes, Lemma 26.14.1 (Tag 01JB) for the uniqueness of glued morphisms

proof.text: *Step 5 ($m^{-1}(V_d)$; end of part (c)).* Let $d\in E$. If $e+e'=d$ then $m(W_{e,e'})\subseteq V_d$ by Step 4, so $\bigcup_{e+e'=d}W_{e,e'}\subseteq m^{-1}(V_d)$. Conversely, let $x\in m^{-1}(V_d)$. By (a) there is $(e,e')$ with $x\in W_{e,e'}$, and then $m(x)\in V_{e+e'}\cap V_d$ by Step 4; since $V_{e+e'}\cap V_d=\varnothing$ unless $e+e'=d$ (Step 1, from [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-coproduct-family]), we get $e+e'=d$ and $x\in\bigcup_{e+e'=d}W_{e,e'}$. Hence $m^{-1}(V_d)=\bigcup_{e+e'=d}W_{e,e'}$, which with Step 4 proves (c).
